description: This Java class defines configuration properties for downstream service clients used by the checkout-service in a Spring Boot application. It includes nested classes and validation annotations for properties like base URL and timeout.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration properties for multiple service clients, with nested class for individual properties.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties.ServiceClientProperties
classes.description: Represents individual service client configuration, including base URL and timeout.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the cart service client.

methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the order service client.

methods.name: getPricing
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the pricing service client.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the tax service client.

methods.name: getPromotions
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the promotions service client.

methods.name: getInventory
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the inventory service client.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the payment service client.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the shipping service client.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Gets the base URL of the service client.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Sets the base URL of the service client.

methods.name: getTimeoutMs
methods.description: Gets the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.

methods.name: setTimeoutMs
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.
